listening_queue.text: मेरा नाम प्रिया है और मैं दिल्ली में रहती हूँ।
Kal ki meeting teen baje hai, please apna laptop le aana.
Sriram Venkataraman, Aishwarya Iyer and Gurpreet Singh Dhillon joined the call from Thiruvananthapuram.
Dr. Sharma lives on MG Rd. near the ATM, approx. 5 km from the IIT campus.

Thank you for calling Horizon Bank. Your recent payment has been received, and your account is now up to date. If you would like to hear your balance, please stay on the line, and an agent will help you shortly with any other questions. We also wanted to let you know about our new savings plan, which offers a higher interest rate for customers who keep a minimum balance for twelve months. You can sign up through the mobile app or at any branch, and there are no extra fees to get started. Our branches are open from nine in the morning until five in the evening on weekdays, and from ten until two on Saturdays. For security reasons, we will never ask for your password or one time code over the phone, so please do not share them with anyone. If you notice any unusual activity, contact our support team immediately. The final sentence mentions a purple elephant named Gopal.
